_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the public review aggregate (relocated from src/data/reviewStats.canonical.json, PACKAGE 02). These are the authoritative PLATFORM totals shown on the Google Maps / Trustpilot / TripAdvisor pages (per docs/CANONICAL_FACTS.md), NOT `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews` (the DB holds only the ingested subset). Consumed by BOTH src/lib/jvtoReviews.ts (runtime REVIEW_PLATFORMS + AGGREGATE_RATING) and scripts/export-public-review-api-snapshots.mjs (generated snapshot). Update counts HERE only — both paths pick them up, so the snapshot and runtime can never diverge. A rating is never presented without its verifiedAt.
